title: Spicy Coastal Fish Curry
mainIngredient: King Red Snapper or Sea Bass
description: Authentic coconut and tamarind infused coastal fish curry with freshly ground aromatic spices.
ingredients: 500g fresh fish steaks (Red Snapper or Sea Bass)
1 cup grated fresh coconut or coconut milk
2 fresh red chillies & 1 tbsp turmeric powder
Fresh curry leaves & mustard seeds for tempering
steps: Wash and pat dry the fish steaks. Season with salt and turmeric powder.
Heat mustard oil in a pan, sauté mustard seeds and curry leaves until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and saute until golden brown.
Blend coconut with chillies and spices to form a smooth paste and add to the pan.
Pour 1.5 cups water and tamarind extract; bring curry base to a gentle boil.
Slide in fish steaks and simmer covered for 10-12 minutes until tender. Serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Garlic Butter Pan-Seared Salmon
description: Crispy skin Atlantic salmon pan-seared to perfection in rich garlic, lemon, and fresh dill butter.
ingredients: Fresh dill & black pepper to taste
steps: Pat salmon skin thoroughly dry with paper towels; season skin with sea salt.
Heat skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side down and press firmly for 5 seconds.
Sear for 5 minutes until skin is golden brown and crispy.
Flip salmon, add butter, minced garlic, and lemon juice to pan.
Baste salmon with foaming garlic butter for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with chopped dill.

title: Crispy Golden Fried Calamari & Prawns
description: Light, airy seasoned batter coating succulent jumbo prawns and calamari rings with spicy mayo dip.
steps: Pat seafood completely dry.
Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, salt, and garlic powder together.
Toss prawns and calamari in dry batter mix until evenly coated.
Deep fry in hot oil (180°C/350°F) in small batches for 2-3 minutes until golden crispy.
Drain on paper towel and serve immediately with spicy tartar sauce.

title: Signature Singapore Chili Crab
description: Iconic sweet, savory, and spicy thick egg-ribbon chili sauce over cracked mud crabs.
ingredients: 2 large mud crabs, cleaned and halved
4 tbsp sweet chili sauce & 2 tbsp tomato paste
steps: Stir fry ginger, garlic, and sambal paste in a wok until oil separates.
Add mud crab pieces and toss coat evenly.
Pour in chicken stock, chili sauce, tomato paste, and simmer covered for 10 minutes.
Remove cover, swirl in beaten eggs slowly to create velvety sauce ribbons.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with hot fried mantou buns.
